calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, average the negative close-location value over the latest three completed sessions. Higher values indicate closes nearer the low of the daily range and represent a short-horizon mean-reversion signal. Zero-range observations are missing.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in all three broad validation blocks: 2020-2022 IC 0.05418 (ICIR 0.15140), 2023-2024 IC 0.04125 (ICIR 0.11784), and 2025-2026 IC 0.06952 (ICIR 0.21150). Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
